general.title: General
general.description: Set how the app looks and behaves across your workspace.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: Which sections this campaign shows, in which order and with which names.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Which template each note type uses in this campaign.

general.intro: These preferences update right away so the app matches how you play and run your sessions.

theme.description: Pick the appearance that feels best for everyday use across the whole app.

language.description: Choose the language used in navigation, labels, and messages throughout the app.

rules.title: Templates for this campaign
rules.description: New notes in {{campaign}} start from these templates. Automatic uses _templates/<type>.md when it exists, otherwise the built-in.
rules.noCampaignDescription: Open a campaign, then come back here to choose which template each note type uses.
rules.saveError: Could not save the template choice

library.empty: Select a template to view or edit it.

create.title: New template
create.description: Creates a template in _templates/ at the vault root.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: {{path}} will be deleted permanently. Campaigns using it go back to automatic.

campaignSections.title: Sections of this campaign
campaignSections.description: Reorder, rename or hide the sections of {{campaign}}, or add your own. Folders on disk are never renamed or deleted: hidden sections keep their files.
campaignSections.noCampaignDescription: Open a campaign, then come back here to set up its sections.

create.title: New section
create.description: A section of this campaign only, with its own folder and note type.
create.typeDescription: Written as type: in the frontmatter of its notes. Leave empty to use the name.

edit.title: Edit section
edit.description: Change the name or the icon. The folder and the note type stay as they are, so the notes keep working.
edit.typeDescription: The note type of an existing section cannot change.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: The section leaves this campaign. The {{folder}} folder and its files stay in the vault.

setup.title: Set up your vault
setup.description: LazyDM keeps your campaigns as Markdown files in a folder you own. Choose an existing folder or create a new one.
setup.cloudHint: Pick a folder inside iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Box or OneDrive to use the same vault on all your devices.

existing.label: Existing vault
existing.description: This folder already contains a LazyDM vault. It will be opened as it is.

empty.label: New vault
empty.description: The folder is empty. A new vault will be created here.

nonEmpty.label: New vault
nonEmpty.description: This folder already has files. LazyDM will add its configuration and leave your files untouched.

errors.desktopOnly: Vaults can only be opened in the LazyDM desktop app.
errors.missing: The vault at {{path}} can't be reached. It may have been moved or deleted, or its cloud drive isn't available yet.
errors.readOnly: LazyDM can't write to this folder. Choose a folder you can edit.

sync.overlayDescription: {{provider}} is downloading notes that changed on your other devices. LazyDM opens the vault as soon as they are on this device.
sync.pendingDescription: {{count}} notes are not on this device yet. They will appear as soon as {{provider}} downloads them.
sync.conflictsDescription: Your cloud service created copies of notes edited on two devices at the same time. Review them and delete the copy you don't need:

list.title: Campaigns
list.emptyDescription: A campaign is a folder in your vault with scenes, characters, enemies, encounters and sessions. Create your first one to start preparing.

create.title: New campaign
create.description: LazyDM creates a folder for the campaign in your vault, with its default sections.
create.nameDescription: The folder is named after it, with dashes instead of spaces.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: A short summary of the adventure

sections.emptyDescription: Notes you add to the {{folder}} folder of your vault appear here.

scenes.description: Events and moments to run at the table.

enemies.description: Foes, their stat blocks and tactics.

encounters.description: Combats and challenges, ready to run.

handouts.description: Letters, clues and texts to give to the players.

sessions.description: Prep and recaps of each session.

notes.description: Notes without a section of their own.

template.label: Template
template.ariaLabel: Template for new notes in this section

newFolder.title: New folder
newFolder.description: A sub-folder of {{section}}: its name becomes the sub-type of the notes in it (subtype: in the frontmatter). One level only.

toolbar.modeAriaLabel: Switch between writing and reading this note

conflict.title: This note changed elsewhere
conflict.description: Someone — maybe you, on another device — saved a newer version of this note while you were editing. Choose what to do with your changes.

links.noLinkedFiles: No links to or from other files yet.
links.allBroken: All broken links in the campaign

rename.title: Rename note
rename.done: Note renamed — {{links}} links updated in {{notes}} notes
rename.failed: Some notes changed meanwhile and still use the old name

broken.title: Broken links
broken.cardDescription: Links pointing to notes or files that don't exist.
broken.emptyDescription: Every link in this campaign points to an existing note or file.

actions.createDescription: A new note for “{{link}}”: the link will point to it.
actions.removed: Link removed — its text stays in the note

list.title: Compendium
list.description: Material shared by every campaign. Copy notes and files here from a campaign, or create them directly, and copy them back into any campaign.
list.emptyDescription: Create a system — a shared folder for a game, a setting or anything you reuse across campaigns.

create.title: New system
create.description: LazyDM creates a folder in the compendium of your vault. Its folders appear as you add notes and files.
create.nameDescription: The folder is named after it, with dashes instead of spaces.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: {{path}} and the {{count}} files in it will be deleted permanently. Campaigns are not affected.

system.description: Shared material: copy notes and files here from a campaign, or create them directly.
system.emptyDescription: Create a note, or use “Copy to compendium” on a note or file of a campaign. Folders appear as you add things.

copy.description: A copy of {{name}} is made; the original stays where it is.
copy.noSystems: Create a system in the compendium first.
copy.existsDescription: {{path}} already exists. Choose another name for the copy.

import.description: Choose a file from the {{section}} folders to copy into {{target}}. The original stays where it is.
import.emptyCompendium: The compendium has nothing in {{section}} yet.
import.emptyCampaigns: Your campaigns have nothing in {{section}} yet.

linked.title: Linked files
linked.description: This file links to files {{target}} doesn't have: {{files}}. Files it already has are not copied again.

review.title: Review
review.emptyDescription: Every note is in the section of its type and every link resolves.
review.alertDescription: Some notes, folders or links do not match the sections of this campaign.

misplaced.title: Misplaced notes
misplaced.description: Their type belongs to another section.

wrongSubtype.title: Wrong sub-types
wrongSubtype.description: Their sub-type is not the sub-folder they are in.

untyped.title: Notes without a type
untyped.description: Written outside LazyDM (Obsidian, Finder…) without a type: in the frontmatter.

outside.title: Outside any section
outside.description: Notes at the campaign root or in no section folder.

unknownFolders.title: Unknown folders
unknownFolders.description: Folders of this campaign that are not one of its sections. Their notes do not show in the sidebar.

tooDeep.title: Folders too deep
tooDeep.description: LazyDM uses one level of sub-folders: files in deeper folders do not appear in sections.

fixAll.title: Update {{count}} notes?
fixAll.description: Only the frontmatter changes (type and sub-type); every write is checked against changes made meanwhile.

move.title: Move {{title}}
move.description: The note keeps its name; its type follows the section and the links to it are updated.

addSection.title: Add {{folder}} as a section
addSection.description: The folder becomes a section of this campaign with its notes; nothing is moved or renamed.
